description: Night scene in an oil-paint style. A young man in a dark jacket stands on a heavy olive-green tank holding a large white, blue and red horizontal-striped flag aloft. Several other young people crowd the turret and hull, some raising fists. Behind them is a tall pale modernist government-style building with lit windows, with searchlight beams, smoke and a small fire in the background, and a crowd below. Dress is late-Soviet-era jeans, leather jackets and work jackets. No visible text, no frame, no gore.
